lines.zh: 我踩在风里，像走在云上。
lines.en: I walk on wind, as if on cloud.

lines.zh: 我的皮甲被风吹得作响。
lines.en: The wind rattles my leather armor.

lines.zh: 我一步步后退，拉开距离。
lines.en: I step back to open the range.
I climb by treading the air.
I move slowly, holding height.
I drift across the ground, never touching.
I circle you in midair.

lines.zh: 我的骨头很轻，走得很飘。
lines.en: My bones are light; I float as I walk.
I retreat far, then plant myself.
I shift sideways with the wind.
I hover with my bow in hand.
Clouds gather above me.
I draw the string once, slowly.
Wind spirals around my bones.
I wait for an opening.
There is no face beneath my skull.
I raise the bow, then lower it.
Thunder rolls in the distance.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像挂在空中。
lines.en: I hang motionless in the air.
I turn my wrist slowly.
Air currents draw in around me.

lines.zh: 我的蓝皮甲在光里发暗。
lines.en: My blue leather darkens in the light.
I glance upward.

lines.zh: 我在数自己还剩几支箭。
lines.en: I'm counting my remaining arrows.
The wind stops, and so do I.
I wait for this storm to rise.
You look up and find no face.
I turn the bow toward you, slowly.
You stand firm in the wind.

lines.zh: 我在你上方，你没有发现。
lines.en: I'm above you; you haven't noticed.
My arrows outrun the wind.
I tilt my skull at you.
You haven't backed off; I'm interested.
A cloud shadow passes your feet.
I've called some small things.

lines.zh: 你肩膀的高度，我量过一次。
lines.en: I measured your shoulder height once.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，风灌进空空的胸腔。
lines.en: I open my mouth; wind pours through my hollow chest.
My arrowhead stays on you.
My bones rattled once.
I didn't expect that blow.
I float a little higher.
No pain, only loosened joints.
The wind steadies me.
I raise the bow again.
You found a gap.
My swarm has scattered.
I've noted the arrow's direction.
It isn't over yet.
That's useless to my bow.
You hold it up; I won't come down.

lines.zh: 我看了它一眼，没有兴趣。
lines.en: One glance; no interest.
I let the wind push it aside.
You're wasting your own time.

lines.zh: 我落低一点，看看是什么。
lines.en: I drop a little to see what it is.

lines.zh: 这点东西换不来我的弓。
lines.en: That won't buy my bow.
I have no stomach and no need.
Put it away; don't hold it up.
I move my gaze back to you.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，穿过的是一阵风。
lines.en: You charge through nothing but a gust.
I slip aside and you grasp air.
My bones are light; you can't catch them.
The current pushes you away.
I rise a stretch higher.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的影子，我不在意。
lines.en: You stepped on my shadow; I don't mind.
The wind has carried me behind you.

lines.zh: 这点碰撞连风都算不上。
lines.en: That bump isn't even wind.
I rise another half block.
You still can't reach me.
Another skeleton rises.
A cloud-formed head hangs above you.

lines.zh: 风把我卷起来，也卷着你。
lines.en: The wind lifts me. And you.
We draw our bowstrings together.
Its skull is white.
Thunder rolls between us.
We circle the same eye of wind.
In this moment the wind is still.
The storm is coming; we'll meet it together.
We drift slowly into the clouds.
I pick it up with two finger bones.
It's too heavy; I won't take it.
The wind blows it to my hand.
I look, then drop it.
I have no pockets.
It falls through my ribs.

lines.zh: 我把它抛到空中再接住。
lines.en: I toss it up and catch it.
Arrows are worth keeping more.

lines.zh: 我把它挂在一根骨头上。
lines.en: I hang it on a bone.
This can't be carried off.

lines.zh: 骨头里响了一声，我就知道你来了。
lines.en: A click in my bones tells me you've come.
Good, you're chosen.
I draw the bow full.
The wind starts blowing your way.

lines.zh: 蠹虫在我身边卷成龙卷。
lines.en: Silverfish spiral around me into a funnel.
Something stirs in the clouds.
You're in my range.

lines.zh: 我从云里压下来，弓已经满。
lines.en: I drop out of the cloud, bow already full.
A few silverfish circle you first.
You'll hear the string.
I won't hold back today.
The storm starts with me.
When you look up, my arrow is there first.

lines.zh: 你跑不远的，风在我这边。
lines.en: You won't get far. The wind is mine.
The arrow is nocked.
Good, let us begin.
I move first.
The wind comes with me.
I follow you in midair.
You run; my arrow waits.
I gauge the wind.
The cloud shadow crosses your position.
I raise the bow a little.

lines.zh: 你拐进树后，我也换了角度。
lines.en: You slip behind a tree; I change my angle.

lines.zh: 我把几只小东西放了出去。
lines.en: I release a few small things.
They spin into a whirlwind.
You're dodging them; good.
This is the opening I wanted.

lines.zh: 风把我的箭托高了一寸。
lines.en: The wind lifts my arrow an inch.
I draw full once more.
Your gasping muddles the wind.
The wind won't help you.

lines.zh: 你退到箭够不着的地方。
lines.en: You back out of arrow range.
My fingers loose, and the string still sings.
My bowstring has sounded.
This is the arrow.
Good, very good, just so.
Let us go another round.
One arrow cuts the air.
Wind carries my arrow faster.
The impact shoves you back.
I draw the bow again.
Those small things struck you.
I descend and strike with the bow.
You blocked that well.
I retreat back into the air.
Wind rolls the dust into a wall.

lines.zh: 换了个角度，箭还在弦上。
lines.en: Changed the angle; the arrow stays nocked.
Charge still clings to my bones.
You've backed onto open ground.
I raise the bow slowly.

lines.zh: 箭袋见底了，我改用弓身。
lines.en: My quiver runs low; I swing the bow itself.
The clouds sag and I descend.
The wind rises first, then me.
The Storm has arrived.
I take shape out of the storm cloud.
My bowstring hums in the wind.
I hang above your head.
The air tastes of charge.
My blue leather turns the wind.
I've called a swarm of small things.
They circle my bones.
The storm cloud closes behind me.
There's nowhere for you to hide.
I turn my bow crosswise.
The thunder is very near.
I raise my gaze slowly.
Wind scours the ground clean.
I've come, and won't leave easily.

lines.zh: 你抬头，正好对上我的箭。
lines.en: You look up into my arrow.
In this moment, the wind stopped.
Now, let me see what you are.
Fire passes over my bones, hot.

lines.zh: 我从空中坠下去，摔散了。
lines.en: I plummet and come apart.
Water fills my frame and I sink.

lines.zh: 爆风把我的骨架整片吹散。
lines.en: The blast blows my frame apart.
An arrow lodges in my collarbone.
The light presses me still.

lines.zh: 我没有血肉，只是变慢了。
lines.en: I have no flesh; I only slow down.

lines.zh: 雷打中我，我反而更有力。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and I grow stronger.
No wind here to hold me.
